steps.text: If the player recently asked to be cooked something:

steps.npc: I distinctly remember you saying you were going to stop talking to me. Yet here you are again, yakking on and on in my earhole when I'm trying to cook! What do you want now?
What do you want? I'm busy!

steps.prompt: What would you like to say?

steps.player: Well, you're meant to be a cook. Why can't you cook something for me?

steps.npc: I don't want to, that's why! Now, leave me alone.

steps.player: You're not a very nice man.

steps.npc: Yet you keep talking to me!

steps.player: Good point. I should stop that.

steps.npc: Yes, do us both a favour.
Why do you think I work in a disreputable inn filled with rough scoundrels on the very edge of the Wilderness? I work here because I need the job!
Like it? It's sucked the warmth and humanity out of me, and I've become a hollow shell holding nothing but anger, misery and gourmet recipes.
What did you expect to hear? I suppose you expected me to tell you an inspiring story about how working here can teach you to find hope in the darkest places, or how to see the best in everything?

steps.player: Maybe you should think about moving to a different inn.

steps.npc: Bah! I'm not letting it defeat me. Now, let me concentrate on my cooking.

options.text: Can you tell me any good jokes?

steps.player: Can you tell me any good jokes?

steps.npc: What did the half-wit say to the cook?
[He/She/They] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
